title: Maximum Score of a Good Subarray

solutions.optimal:
class Solution:
    def maximumScore(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        n=len(nums); l=r=k; mn=nums[k]; best=mn
        while l > 0 or r < n-1:
            if l == 0: r += 1
            elif r == n-1: l -= 1
            elif nums[l-1] < nums[r+1]: r += 1
            else: l -= 1
            mn=min(mn,nums[l],nums[r])
            best=max(best,mn*(r-l+1))
        return best
